featured_reviews.review_text: I recently placed an order from Theobroma website for delivery from Antop Hill shop. By mistake, I chose time slot as 10-11 pm instead of 10-11 am. featured_reviews.name: Nitesh Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at the antophill branch of Theobroma.

I am a regular customer and have purchased cakes from Theobroma many times for birthdays and special occasions, including from the thakur village & Borivali branch. However, during my recent visit at antophil branch I asked a staff member named Sayad Ali to cut the cake after purchasing, He refused and told me that "he will not cut the cake because he is muslim " these are his words  and that he told me to cut it myself and we where purchasing the whole 1/2 kg  butterscoth cake.

As a customer, this was shocking and unacceptable. Personal religious beliefs should not interfere with basic customer service. Refusing to provide a simple service like cutting a cake reflects poorly on the brand. He should not work at theobrama and he should be removed immedatley .

Theobroma is an international brand known for its professionalism and customer experience. I hope the management takes this matter seriously and ensures that such incidents do not happen again.

Very disappointed with this experience

featured_reviews.review_text:
Celebrated my son birthday. Though service and food quality was good still I will think 10 times before organizing a party here again. It's not a mistake of the staff there but management need to think about it.
599 per head for 5 items. Very high for any place. Over and above 4000 booking charge which I don't understand anyway . Technically it makes per head cost to 899. Which is beyond my understanding.
One person didn't had a food at all and infact we ordered  seperately for her as she was jain. Even for her they charged us over and above charge for the seperate single jain order .
Though we enjoyed. Food was pretty good and service was fast i will avoid going here again because of high charges. It's not about the money it was all about value for money. Cake was nice but 1600 per kg. Outrageous.
And again saying my complain is not against the team there but the management. People will not use your service if the cost is not look after.
3600 for 2 hrs host. U cannot bring your own host. Overall good food but not so good experience

featured_reviews.name: Chandni Hegde
featured_reviews.review_text: This place has a beautiful lavender themed aesthetic, picture perfect and full of calming vibes. It’s a pure veg restaurant with a lovely ambience that instantly lifts your mood. The staff were incredibly friendly, cracking jokes with us and making sure we had everything we needed. They even clicked pictures for us when we asked, which definitely made our experience even better. The desserts and savoury items displayed at the counter are all worth trying. However, the food we ordered from the menu, corn cheese balls, Manchurian gravy and fried rice, turned out to be a bit too salty, making it hard to enjoy without water or a drink on the side. Apart from that, the quality was great and overall I had a really pleasant and memorable experience here. Oh and also on Tuesdays you get a complimentary Blueberry Cheesecake or Brownie!

featured_reviews.name: Esha Goyal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ordered a Dutch Truffle Bento Cake expecting something close to what was advertised but what i received looked rushed, sloppy, and frankly careless. The frosting was uneven, the writing was messy and poorly done, and the overall presentation was nowhere near the standard shown in their own listing.

For a product marketed for “mini celebrations,” this was genuinely embarrassing to put in front of someone.

Only after a lot of back-and-forth and unnecessary arguing did they agree to fix it, which they eventually did, but that doesn’t undo the inconvenience or the fact that quality control clearly isn’t a priority here.

Customers shouldn’t have to fight to get what they already paid for. Disappointing experience overall. Would not recommend unless you’re prepared to chase them for basic quality.

featured_reviews.name: Rafat Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:

Their cakes are not only beautifully customized but also super delicious. I tried their snacks and some food from the menu too—everything was fresh and full of flavor. You can tell a lot of love and detail goes into what they serve.

If you’re someone who appreciates good food and a great ambiance, this place is a must-visit! Will definitely be going back to try more from their menu.

featured_reviews.review_text:

When I told the waiter why it's cold it was reheated in oven and brought back claiming new fries are given but it wasn't as one can easily see the difference!
Later on he took it back and insisted to have plain salted fries.

Out of courtesy I said yes but what turned out was shocking! As salt almost 3 times was put in the fries as you can see in the image and instead of raising a complain again we had to remove salt with the other hand and eat the fries which was embarassing to say the least.
Found strands of a couple of hair in the fries as well.

Definitely didn't expect this from Lavender.
Disappointing.

Wide variety of desserts.
Reasonable Menu.
I just wish they can get better with the cleanliness of the 🪑🪑chair.
Menu is on the budget.
Also pav bhaji and pasta served so variety is not restricted to mere dessert.

featured_reviews.name: Trupti Pandey
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved my experience at Lavender Café 💜✨
The ambience is super aesthetic and gives total Pinterest vibes—perfect for a chill hangout or a cute date. The highlight for me was their seasonal mango menu 🥭—every bite felt fresh, rich, and full of real mango flavor. The desserts were beautifully presented and tasted even better, especially the pull-me-up dessert which was soft, creamy, and just the right amount of sweet.
Service was quick and the staff was polite and attentive. Overall, a perfect place if you’re looking for good food, great vibes, and Instagram-worthy moments. Definitely visiting again!

featured_reviews.name: Shaista Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Thank u so much for lovely cake 🎂 & taste toh wow tha thank u so much for everything plz visit All & try

featured_reviews.name: Ojasi Ramdas Gaikwad
featured_reviews.review_text:
The cake was absolutely delicious! 🍰 The efforts you put in to make it look exactly like the photo I had shared were amazing. We all loved it, especially my mom—she really enjoyed it! Thank you so much for thoughtfully adding extra almonds after you came to know she likes them. That was very kind.

The chocolate inside, the base, the cream—its texture and taste—everything was just perfect. The white base with all the beautiful detailing made it look even better. We truly loved the cake, thank you once again! ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Rajnish_17 Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried their pizza and cheesecake — both were amazing!
The pizza was hot, cheesy, and full of flavor. And the cheesecake was just the right amount of creamy and sweet. Loved the overall vibe of the place too. Definitely coming back!

featured_reviews.name: Umera Choudhary
featured_reviews.review_text: So I went to this place for the first time and l kid you not like the cakes the donuts everything was perfect the staff was very friendly and helpful and the taste omg like being a donut lover I can tell they have one of the best donuts and way too affordable prices also tried their truffle cake pastry as well has blueberry cheesecake which was a solid 10/10 loved it.

featured_reviews.name: Dr. Intesar Khatri
featured_reviews.review_text: Forget those nearby over-rated Theobroma and Monginis! Mellofy never disappoints with its cake! Always open till late night for last minute takeaways and bites.

featured_reviews.name: NIRMAL BEHERA
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved this place!
The refreshments are super refreshing and the savouries are full of flavour. Perfect spot for a quick bite or a chill break. Cozy ambiance and great service too — definitely worth visiting!

featured_reviews.name: Next Thang
featured_reviews.review_text: Clean place with some extra ordinary snacks with delicious taste, would like to visit once a week. The hospitality is top notch, the owner is sweet and beautiful 😍. Overall I would rate 9/10 for this place.
